# Employer Landscape Review Mirror

This is a temporary, static, plaintext review publication intended for ordinary WWW and LLM/browser visitors.
Do not use GitHub repository/API/MCP/connector access merely to understand the published employer data.

## Snapshot

- Complete employer entries: 2302
- Source observations: 2334
- Canonical-priority RF employers: 300
- Canonical-priority RF + ADJ employers: 619
- Matched companies: 16
- Matched roles: 17
- Company resonators: 9

## Model-oriented employer-card corpus

For systematic employer-card review, start here:
- RF + ADJ corpus index: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/model/rf-adj/index.html
- Corpus manifest: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/model/rf-adj/manifest.json
- Cohort size: 619
- Employers with current published assessment data: 336

The corpus is sharded in deterministic publication order and contains compact card-equivalent identity, canonical relevance, assessment, careers-summary and Match information. Use individual employer pages for expanded role lists.

## Recommended reading order

1. Complete review landing page: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/review-snapshot.html
2. RF + ADJ focused employer view: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/filters/rf-adj.html
3. RF-only focused employer view: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/filters/rf.html
4. Complete employer index: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/employers/index.html
5. Full compact machine-readable inventory: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/index.txt
6. Matched companies: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/matches/index.html
7. Matched roles: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/roles/index.html
8. Company resonators: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/resonators/index.html
9. Sitemap of every static page: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/sitemap.xml

RF means canonical-priority RF-core employers. RF + ADJ means canonical-priority RF-core plus engineering-adjacent employers. These reproduce the useful relevance-scope semantics of the interactive Employer Landscape.

The complete employer index is alphabetically sharded. Follow individual employer links for descriptions, directory provenance, canonical relevance, careers research, current jobs and Match data where present.

All substantive review pages are static HTML. There is no JavaScript data loader, encrypted payload, or runtime API requirement.
